author: Davidgo5867

english.text: At the pizzeria on the 27th of March of 2015, Yaroslav the Ukrainian and I discuss many things. He says that his town in Ukraine is Kharkov (in Russian) or Kharkiv (in Ukrainian). We talk about the palatial subway or train stations in Russia, Uzbekistan, France, etc. Yaroslav's white Canadian neighbour in Vancouver is always drunk, he says, and may have a bit of Native Indian ancestry. We talk about how English slang is not a good habit. Many immigrants here in Canada do not speak slang. Yaroslav still likes learning English. I tell him that when I came to Canada at age 10, I could read English, but I did not speak well. It took me about a year to get accustomed to speaking English.

jyutping: hai2 2015 nin4 3 jyut6 27 hou6 ge3 bok6 beng2 pou2，ngo5 tung4 wu1 hak1 laan4 jan4 ngaa5 lo4 si1 laai1 fu1 tou2 leon6 zo2 hou2 do1 je5。keoi5 waa6 keoi5 hai2 wu1 hak1 laan4 ge3 zan3 hai6 haa1 ji5 fo1 fu1（ngo4 man2）waak6 ze2 haa1 ji5 fo1 fu1（wu1 hak1 laan4 man4）。ngo5 dei6 gong2 gan2 ngo4 lo4 si1、wu1 zi1 bit6 haak1 si1 taan2、faat3 gwok3 dang2 dang2 ge3 gung1 ting4 sik1 ge3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 waak6 ze2 fo2 ce1 zaam6。keoi5 waa6，ngaa5 lo4 si1 laai1 fu1 hai2 wan1 go1 waa4 ge3 gaa1 naa4 daai6 baak6 jan4 leon4 geoi1 seng4 jat6 dou1 jam2 zeoi3，ho2 nang4 jau5 siu2 siu2 jan3 dai6 on1 jyun4 zyu6 man4 ge3 hyut3 tung2。ngo5 dei6 gong2 gan2 jing1 man2 lei5 jyu5 hai6 dim2 joeng2 m4 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 zaap6 gwaan3。nei1 dou6 gaa1 naa4 daai6 hou2 do1 ji4 man4 dou1 m4 sik1 gong2 lei5 jyu5。ngaa5 lo4 si1 laai1 fu1 zung6 zung1 ji3 hok6 jing1 man2。ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2，dong1 ngo5 sap6 seoi3 lai4 dou3 gaa1 naa4 daai6 go2 zan6，ngo5 sik1 tai2 jing1 man2，daan6 hai6 ngo5 gong2 dak1 m4 hou2。ngo5 jung6 zo2 daai6 joek3 jat1 nin4 si4 gaan3 heoi3 zaap6 gwaan3 gong2 jing1 man2。
text: 喺2015年3月27號嘅薄餅舖，我同烏克蘭人雅羅斯拉夫討論咗好多嘢。佢話佢喺烏克蘭嘅鎮係哈爾科夫（俄文）或者哈爾科夫（烏克蘭文）。我哋講緊俄羅斯、烏茲別克斯坦、法國等等嘅宮廷式嘅地鐵站或者火車站。佢話，雅羅斯拉夫喺溫哥華嘅加拿大白人鄰居成日都飲醉，可能有少少印第安原住民嘅血統。我哋講緊英文俚語係點樣唔係一個好習慣。呢度加拿大好多移民都唔識講俚語。雅羅斯拉夫仲鍾意學英文。我同佢講，當我十歲嚟到加拿大嗰陣，我識睇英文，但係我講得唔好。我用咗大約一年時間去習慣講英文。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 28th of June of 2013. On the Web, I have encountered other Latinate conlangs besides Interlingua. But because Interlingua was created by a very professional committee, I opine that Interlingua is the best of the Blues. Many would agree with me if they had the chance to peruse other brands. Interlingua was developed between 1937 and 1951 by the International Auxiliary Language Association (IALA), so it already has a long history.

jyutping: hai6 2013 nin4 6 jyut6 28 hou6。hai2 mong5 soeng6，ceoi4 zo2 Interlingua zi1 ngoi6，ngo5 zung6 jyu6 dou3 gwo3 kei4 taa1 laai1 ding1 man2 ge3 conlang。daan6 jan1 wai6 Interlingua hai6 jau4 jat1 go3 hou2 zyun1 jip6 ge3 wai2 jyun4 wui2 cong3 laap6，so2 ji5 ngo5 jing6 wai4 Interlingua hai6 laam4 diu6 jap6 min6 zeoi3 hou2 ge3。jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 dei6 jau5 gei1 wui6 tai2 haa2 kei4 taa1 ban2 paai4，hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui6 tung4 ji3 ngo5 ge3 gong2 faat3。Interlingua hai6 jau4 gwok3 zai3 fu6 zo6 jyu5 jin4 hip3 wui2（IALA）hai2 1937 zi3 1951 nin4 gaan1 faat3 zin2 ceot1 lai4，so2 ji5 keoi5 ji5 ging1 jau5 hou2 coeng4 ge3 lik6 si2。
text: 係2013年6月28號。喺網上，除咗 Interlingua 之外，我仲遇到過其他拉丁文嘅conlang。但因為Interlingua係由一個好專業嘅委員會創立，所以我認為Interlingua係藍調入面最好嘅。如果佢哋有機會睇吓其他品牌，好多人都會同意我嘅講法。Interlingua係由國際輔助語言協會（IALA）喺1937至1951年間發展出嚟，所以佢已經有好長嘅歷史。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: According to Shinto, at the death of a person, there are several possible destinations: in the young life far beyond the ocean, in the invisible astral world, in the underworld, or in the mountains to watch out for family survivors. In Shinto, the notion exists that a person may become a "kami." There are many "kami," and they are sometimes called "kamigami." Sometimes, the Japanese call God "Kami-sama." Often, "kami" also means spirits or souls, not just gods.

jyutping: gan1 geoi3 san4 dou6 ge3 gong2 faat3，dong1 jat1 go3 jan4 sei2 zo2 zi1 hau6，jau5 gei2 go3 ho2 nang4 ge3 muk6 dik1 dei6：hai2 jyun5 lei4 hoi2 joeng4 ge3 nin4 hing1 sang1 ming6 zung1，hai2 jan2 jing4 ge3 sing1 gaai3，hai2 hak1 se5 wui2，waak6 ze2 hai2 saan1 soeng6，heoi3 lau4 ji3 gaa1 ting4 hang6 cyun4 ze2。 hai2 san4 dou6 gaau3 jap6 min6，jau5 go3 koi3 nim6 hai6 jat1 go3 jan4 ho2 nang4 wui5 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3「san4」。 jau5 hou2 do1「san4」，jau5 si4 jik6 dou1 giu3 zou6「san4」。 jau5 si4，jat6 bun2 jan4 wui5 giu3 soeng6 dai3 zou6「san4 daai6 jan4」。 hou2 do1 si4，「san4」jik6 dou1 hai6 zi2 ling4 wan4 waak6 ze2 ling4 wan4，m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 san4。
text: 根據神道嘅講法，當一個人死咗之後，有幾個可能嘅目的地：喺遠離海洋嘅年輕生命中，喺隱形嘅星界，喺黑社會，或者喺山上，去留意家庭幸存者。 喺神道教入面，有個概念係一個人可能會成為一個「神」。 有好多「神」，有時亦都叫做「神」。 有時，日本人會叫上帝做「神大人」。 好多時，「神」亦都係指靈魂或者靈魂，唔係淨係神。

It resembled a festival for grown-ups. An individual could get lost for quite a long time in a spot like this.

text: 賭博俱樂部播放咗佢自己嘅旋律遊戲機叮叮聲，當賣家將啲薯片遞畀張檯嘅玩家嗰陣，薯片啲啪啪聲，同埋啲人用渴望成為狂野成功嘅慾望扔現金嘅嘈雜聲。呢個好似一個大人嘅節日噉。喺呢個噉嘅地方，一個人可能會迷路幾耐。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: “I fluctuate between wanting to mark Brexit quietly but symbolically with some friends in Berlin, or just staying home with my husband and going across the road to our local bar for a couple of strong cocktails. Or maybe just going to bed and hiding under the duvet. Whatever I end up doing, the mood deep down will be sadness,” she said.

jyutping: 「ngo5 wui5 hai2 soeng2 tung4 paak3 lam4 di1 pang4 jau5 zing6 zing6 dei2 daan6 zoeng6 zing1 sing3 gam2 hing3 zuk1 jing1 gwok3 tyut3 au1 zi1 gaan1，ding6 hai6 zi2 hai6 tung4 lou5 gung1 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2，jin4 hau6 heoi3 deoi3 min6 ngo5 dei6 dong1 dei6 ge3 zau2 baa1 jam2 loeng5 bui1 nung4 lit6 ge3 gai1 mei5 zau2。waak6 ze2 ho2 nang4 zi2 hai6 soeng5 cong4 fan3 gaau3，jin4 hau6 nik1 hai2 zoeng1 pei5 haa6 min6。mou4 leon6 ngo5 zeoi3 hau6 zou6 mat1，ngo5 noi6 sam1 sam1 cyu3 ge3 sam1 cing4 dou1 wui5 hai6 bei1 soeng1。」
text: 「我會喺想同柏林啲朋友靜靜地但象徵性噉慶祝英國脫歐之間，定係只係同老公留喺屋企，然後去對面我哋當地嘅酒吧飲兩杯濃烈嘅雞尾酒。或者可能只係上床瞓覺，然後匿喺張被下面。無論我最後做乜，我內心深處嘅心情都會係悲傷。」
